payload.reason: The evidence provides specific deep learning methods used in the context of hate speech detection, including FastText, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), and Long Short-Term Memory Networks (LSTMs).

claims.text: The deep learning methods investigated for hate speech detection include FastText, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), and Long Short-Term Memory Networks (LSTMs).
The paper compares deep learning methods against traditional feature extraction methods like char n-grams, TF-IDF, and Bag of Words.
